---
title: Glossary
roles: all
---
## model
The Claude version that does the work: Haiku, Sonnet or Opus.

## effort
How much thinking Claude does before it answers.

## context window
How much text Claude can hold in mind at once.

## prompt
The instruction you give Claude.

## Project
A Claude workspace with its own instructions and files.

## skill
A packaged set of instructions Claude loads when relevant.

## connector
A link between Claude and another tool.

## MCP
Model Context Protocol, the standard connectors use.

## memory
What Claude keeps between chats.

## agent
Claude working through steps with tools.

## token
A piece of text, roughly a short word.

## Personal Workspace
Your private Context Builder workspace.

## scope
Where Context Builder knowledge lives.

## node
One typed item in the Context Builder graph.
